newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain RTVE see total debt 440 bln pta by year end.
newsitem.headline: Spain RTVE see total debt 440 bln pta by year end.

text.p: Spain's public television channel RTVE expects to show an accumulated debt of around 440 billion pesetas by the end of this year, recently appointed director general Fernando Lopez Amor said on Wednesday.

"A firm, which is expecting to have an accumulated debt of 440 billion pesetas at the end of the year and revenues, for advertising and money from the state, at around 80 billion pesetas is, of course in a difficult situation," Lopez Amor said.

Regarding digital television, Lopez Amor said Spain has to be ready for the launch of the new technology. The RTVE director said he prefers a single platform "which will include all different channels, private and public, without any position of dominance".
